entries.testName: FLAG-002 — staged restore refuses a target that gains a product row and leaves all canonical rows and R2 originals unchanged
entries.reason: A native D1 trigger inserts a real product group only after the run's initial prepareRestore emptiness check and during tracked R2 admission; the final atomic empty-target guard must refuse publication. This revised race construction has not yet been rerun.

entries.testName: FLAG-002 — restore rechecks current setup-owner authority inside the canonical D1 commit after archive admission
entries.reason: Revokes the admitting owner's setup-owner bit inside native D1 after archive admission, compensates the ACL epoch to isolate the atomic current-authority guard, and checks a failed receipt with no canonical or R2 partial restore.

entries.testName: FLAG-002 — a second empty target restores the complete archive, imported originals, foreign keys and fresh owner authority
entries.reason: Uses a separate empty bootstrap target for positive native D1/R2 recovery, verifies complete table counts, imported original bytes, FK integrity and fresh owner routes. This is local recovery evidence, not sealed prior-store or release qualification.

entries.testName: FLAG-003 — frozen comparison pins equal source, question, audience and model limits before policy and index drift
entries.reason: Real evaluation preparation preserves the exact development case, source revision, audience, method/tools, question, route, model, and output limit across candidate and generic runs. Reauthorization blocks current policy-ceiling drift, while poisoned derived search text cannot replace the pinned evidence packet. Synthetic development setup does not establish held-out or requirement-level value.

entries.testName: FLAG-003 — current source grant revocation blocks both prepared runs before disclosure
entries.reason: A real grant is present and the owner resolves the exact private source before preparation, then revocation through the sharing service makes direct resolution and both native worker admissions fail before provider transport. This is a bounded revocation regression, not private held-out evidence.

entries.testName: FLAG-003 — candidate comparison retains failed and successful attempt timing and cost status
entries.reason: Controlled native worker transport records two 503 attempts and one valid response for the candidate run; reloaded D1 generation stages and budget rows preserve each time, outcome, known or bounded-uncertain cost, tokens, retry, receipt, and final settlement. Owner attention, expert quality, and useful-value measurements remain null/unclaimed.

entries.testName: FLAG-003 — generic comparison retains failed and successful attempt timing and cost status
entries.reason: Controlled native worker transport records two 503 attempts and one valid response for the generic run; reloaded D1 generation stages and budget rows preserve each time, outcome, known or bounded-uncertain cost, tokens, retry, receipt, and final settlement.
